title: Hearst Castle

services.name: School Tours
services.desc: Available all year long, Accessibly Designed tours provide alternate tour route experiences that are wheelchair accessible, designed for visitors who have difficulty climbing up and down stairs, or who cannot stand or walk for lengths of time. Tours are able to access the gardens, pools, and ground floor interior rooms of Casa Grande or the cottages, depending on the tour route. Current Accessible tour offerings are Grand Rooms Accessible (ADA), Art Under the Moonlight Accessible (ADA), and Holiday Twilight Accessible (ADA). Wheelchairs and mobility assistance devices up to 28 inches in width can be accommodated at the Castle. Wheelchairs are also available at no additional charge. Unleash
